title: NVIDIA Extends Industrial AI Reach While Valuation And Execution Remain In Focus
text: NVIDIA (NasdaqGS:NVDA) announced a long term industrial AI alliance with Dassault Systèmes to build AI driven "Virtual Twin" factories. The company released open Earth 2 weather AI models aimed at high resolution, faster climate and weather simulations. NVIDIA expanded logistics automation work with major partners to apply its AI infrastructure to routing, warehousing and supply chain operations. New collaborations with research leaders such as DOE Argonne, RIKEN and Fujitsu target AI...
